summary: `awx-manage host_metric --csv` writes host metric data, a summary and cluster info as CSV; --tarball packages them into one tar file and --rows_per_file <n> limits rows per file.
questions: How do I export host metrics with awx-manage?
How do I split host metric output into files?

answer_card.title: Export host metrics
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
awx-manage host_metric --csv                              # data, summary, cluster info
awx-manage host_metric --tarball                          # one tar file
awx-manage host_metric --tarball --rows_per_file 10000    # cap rows per file
```
